symptom: `container ctnMain (RenderMode: 'Main')` in `create or modify layout` passes check and exec, then `describe layout` prints `container ctnMain (Class: 'app-main')` — reported as "the value isn't stored"; `alter layout … set (RenderMode: …)` refused with `property "RenderMode" is not a property of this built-in widget`
cause: The write was fine: `bson dump` showed `RenderMode: "Main"` on the stored Forms$DivContainer. DESCRIBE's DivContainer branch never read RenderMode (only DynamicText did), the ALTER `rendermode` case routed only dynamic texts and sent containers to the pluggable setter, and buildContainerV3 cast any string straight to the enum, so `'main'` or `'Banner'` was stored verbatim
insight: A report that a value "isn't stored" is usually read off `describe`; run `bson dump` before touching the write path — here it split a suspected write drop into a read-side gap in one command, and the builder had been right all along. The sdk enum had drifted too (`Div`, `Form`; Mendix's set is Div…Address in modelsdk/gen/pages), so take the member list from the generated enum rather than the hand-written one. Control: the four new tests fail on main with `describe dropped the container's RenderMode`, `RenderMode = "main", want Main`, `'Banner' must be refused` and `property "RenderMode" not found on this widget`
